setup.command: if ! command -v go >/dev/null 2>&1; then case $(uname -m) in x86_64) arch=amd64;; aarch64|arm64) arch=arm64;; *) echo "unsupported architecture: $(uname -m)"; exit 1;; esac; curl -sSL -o /tmp/go.tgz https://go.dev/dl/go1.26.5.linux-$arch.tar.gz && tar -C /usr/local -xzf /tmp/go.tgz && ln -sf /usr/local/go/bin/go /usr/local/bin/go && ln -sf /usr/local/go/bin/gofmt /usr/local/bin/gofmt; fi && go version
